output_list.criticism: The vulnerability is caused by the following code segment in the function 'buy': uint amount = msg.value / buyPrice; if (balanceOf[this] < amount ) throw; balanceOf[msg.sender] += amount; balanceOf[this] -= amount; Transfer(this, msg.sender, amount); The vulnerability lies in the calculation of 'amount' in the first line. If 'buyPrice' is less than 1, then 'amount' will be more than the available tokens in the contract. This will cause an integer overflow and result in loss of tokens for the contract owner.
